changelog:
- Initial release of google-maps-contact-extract.
- Extracts business contact info (emails, phones, social media) from Google Maps search results and business websites.
- Supports step-by-step extraction: search Google Maps, fetch place details, visit any listed website for additional contacts.
- Collects social media profiles (Facebook, Instagram, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, Pinterest, Discord).
- Output merges Google Maps data with found website contacts for comprehensive business lead lists.
- Designed for browser-based usage; only reads data visible to the user.
summary: Extracts business contact details from Google Maps search results and place detail pages, then visits each business website to collect emails, phone numbers, and social media profiles (Facebook, Instagram, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, Pinterest, Discord). Use when user mentions Google Maps
